verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a Status Pages product that gives real-time operational insight and lets users "securely communicate" updates. Nothing in the pack shows private or internal pages, audience restriction, or access controls for customer-specific or employee-only viewers. Status pages in general are an adjacent feature, not evidence for this story.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, I can run private or internal status pages with access control for customer-specific or employee-only audiences
